prerequisites: Basic engineering knowledge in the field of manufacturing technology, process equipment and materials science.
Ability to acquire the information from different sources also in foreign languages.
Can formulate and justify its views, participate in the discussion in the field of science and technology, prepare and discuss own presentation.

learning_outcomes.text: Acquire the abilities of developing the editorial and substantive skills in editing master thesis.
Acquiring the abilities to develop research results and to formulate conclusions and to present own work.
Preparing students for the final master exam. The replay of selected information from the field of studies.
Can in a transparent and communicative way prepare and give a presentation, discuss the plan to achieve the master thesis.
Can easily carry on a discussion on master thesis and on topics related to field of study.
Can develop and discuss the topics on the diploma examination and answer to questions.
Has a sense of responsibility for its own work and its impact on the functioning of the company.
Understands necessity of critical discussion of results of the done teamwork.
Understands the need for lifelong learning and development the professional and social skills.

syllabus_topics:
Presentation of the program, the purpose and scope of activities. Overview of the principles of writing master thesis. Distribution of questions to self-develop in the field of the final exam. Determination of the order of master
					’s thesis presentations.
Discussion of the diploma examination questions by the students in the group A
Discussion of the diploma examination questions by the students in the group B
Discussion of the diploma examination questions by the students in the group C
Presentation of theses implementation plan - I group. Discussion.
Presentation of theses implementation plan - II group. Discussion.
Presentation of theses implementation plan - III group. Discussion.
A summary of the seminar. Discussion. Pass.
teaching_methods: self study - self studies and preparation for examination

assessment_methods.method: Rating the presentations, discussion and active participation skills.
Rating of the prepared questions for the final exam

assessment_rules: The concluding grade P is calculated as (0.7 * F1 + 0.3 * F2) / 2, where F1 evaluates presentations, discussion, and active participation, and F2 evaluates prepared questions for the final exam.

degree: Mechanical Engineering and Machine Building (I level, full-time)
